case_number: 2023 INSC 776; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. ________ OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF S.L.P. (CRIMINAL) NO. 3166 OF 2023) & CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. _________ OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF S.L.P. (CRIMINAL) NO. 3167 OF 2023)
summary: Violation of Section 50 NDPS Act safeguard; body search consent letter omitted right to be searched before Magistrate/Gazetted Officer; Constitution Bench precedent in Vijaysinh Jadeja mandates strict compliance; recovery vitiated as conviction based solely on illicit article possession; conviction set aside; appellants acquitted.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellants acquitted.
